title: Can LLMs Give Good Product Advice? A Framework for Diagnosing Failures
abstract: arXiv:2611.20734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating product advice from a language model requires assessing whether the recommendation meets the user's needs and identifying where the model falls short when it does not. However, matching a product mentioned in an online reply cannot answer either question on its own: several products may be suitable, and the recorded answer may itself be poor advice. When shown a community-listed alternative alongside their own sampled car recommendation, six models prefer the alternative in 1.9 to 6.5 percent of eligible disagreements, consistently across both source-blind presentation orders. We propose a diagnostic framework that separates the user's stated needs, the model's added assumptions, candidate generation, filtering, and final choice, with 19 possible failure modes and the evidence needed to assess them. We apply this framework to product-advice data and to a separate product-selection task with externally assigned relevance labels

translated_title: 大语言模型能给出好的产品建议吗？一个用于诊断失败的框架
translated_abstract: 评估语言模型给出的产品建议需要判断推荐是否满足用户需求，并在不满足时定位模型的不足之处。然而，仅仅将在线回复中提到的产品与已有产品进行匹配，无法单独回答这两个问题：可能有多个产品都适合用户，而且被记录下来的答案本身可能就是糟糕的建议。实验中，当向六个模型同时展示社区列出的替代产品与其自身抽样的汽车推荐时，模型在1.9%到6.5%的符合条件的分歧中更偏好替代方案，且这一结果在两种来源盲测的展示顺序下保持一致。我们提出了一个诊断框架，将用户的明确需求、模型额外添加的假设、候选生成、过滤和最终选择分离开来，涵盖19种可能的失败模式以及评估这些失败所需的证据。我们将该框架应用于产品建议数据，以及另一个带有外部相关性标注的产品选择任务。
tldr: 该论文提出一个将大语言模型产品建议过程分解为用户需求、模型假设、候选生成、过滤和最终选择五个环节、并涵盖19种失败模式的诊断框架，用于系统性定位推荐失败的原因。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a diagnostic framework with 19 possible failure modes that decomposes LLM product advice into stated user needs, model assumptions, candidate generation, filtering, and final choice, enabling systematic diagnosis of recommendation failures.
